_comment: QWK network (QWKnet) node configuration. Each network is a hub this system polls by FTP: it uploads <hubId>.REP and downloads <hubId>.QWK. Message areas join a network by setting area_type to qwknet, network to the key below, and qwk_conference to the hub's conference number. Use the config editor's QWK Network Wizard (Echomail Networking) to set one up.
